info.title: Perfume Shop API
info.description: RESTful API for a perfume and cologne e-commerce platform with multi-variant product support, allowing flexible volume-based pricing and weight-based sales

get.description: Retrieve all users with pagination and sorting (Admin only)

post.description: Create a new product with cover image, volumes, categories and brand (Admin only)

400.description: Validation error or cover image not provided

content.example: Guerlain is a renowned French luxury brand...

parentId.description: Parent category ID (MongoDB ObjectId, optional for root categories)

patch.description: Update shipping address and/or payment method

get.description: Retrieve a specific address by ID (user must own it or be admin)

403.description: Permission denied - address belongs to another user

delete.description: Delete an existing address (user must own it or be admin)

patch.description: Update an existing address (user must own it or be admin)

get.description: Generate a new CAPTCHA for registration/login

post.description: Create a new user account with email and password

name.description: User full name (3-25 chars, no numbers)

password.description: Min 8 chars, max 64, must include letter, number, special char (@,_,#,$,!)

post.description: Authenticate user with email and password
Logout user and revoke refresh token
Get a new access token using refresh token from cookie

patch.description: Change password and logout from all devices

post.description: Send password reset link to user email

message.example: If an account with that email address exists, a password reset link has been sent.

post.description: Reset password using the token sent to email
Send a new email verification link to authenticated user
Verify user email using the token sent to email

200.description: Your email has been verified successfully

get.description: Retrieve detailed information about an active product

patch.description: Update product details, cover image, and other attributes (Admin only)

404.description: Product or related entity not found

post.description: Add a product variant (volume) to the shopping cart

400.description: Validation error or stock limit exceeded

404.description: Product or volume not found or inactive

patch.description: Increase the quantity of an item in the cart
Decrease the quantity of an item in the cart (removes if quantity becomes 0)

delete.description: Remove a specific item from the shopping cart

post.description: Generate payment link for the checkout session

get.description: Verify payment and create order after successful payment

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: Payment session ID from payment provider

409.description: Checkout was cancelled or insufficient stock

delete.description: Delete a comment and update product ratings if it was approved

patch.description: Change comment status (approve/reject) and optionally add admin reply

replyContent.description: Admin reply to the comment (5-254 characters, optional)

get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific order

patch.description: Update order status and add status history note

404.description: Order not found or has been cancelled

note.description: Optional note to add to status history (max 200 characters)

post.description: Cancel a pending order and restore product stock

400.description: Order already cancelled or not in pending status

post.description: Upload new gallery images (replaces old gallery) (Admin only)

delete.description: Delete all gallery images for a product (Admin only)

get.description: Retrieve all approved comments for a specific product

post.description: Submit a comment and rating for a product

get.description: Retrieve all addresses for a specific user (Admin only)
Retrieve details of a specific user (Admin only)

patch.description: Change user role to ADMIN or USER (Admin only)
Remove ban from a user account (Admin only)
Reactivate a deactivated user account (Admin only)

get.description: Retrieve the authenticated user profile information

delete.description: Deactivate the authenticated user account permanently

name.description: User full name (3-25 characters, no numbers)

post.description: Upload or update user profile picture
